role: form source for the uncovered Undead body

files.undead-tripo.fbx: authoritative: 65 mixamorig bones, 52 used vertex groups, real weights
files.undead-tripo.glb: mesh + maps only; JOINTS_0 is 100% Hips — do not bind from this file
files.textures/: basecolor, normal, roughness, metallic, packed ORM from the FBX .fbm

notes: Use the FBX. The GLB Mixamo names are present but every vertex weight is joint 0.
Rest height is ~0.98 m after the Mixamo 0.01 root; scale to the Undead target (~1.95 m) on bind.
Leaf bones (HeadTop_End, *4 finger tips, Toe_End) exist on the armature and are unused by weights, same as Mixamo.
No animation clips shipped, which is what we want — clips come from public/characters/base.glb.
